Yasuo

the Unforgiven
Mid laneTop laneBot lane

Yasuo is a swordsman who dashes through minions and knocks enemies into the air. He has bonus critical strike chance, a shield that builds as he moves, and a wall that blocks projectiles. Very hard to master, but very rewarding once you click with him.

Nerfed in patch 26.22: His Q scales a little less with attack damage, so crit builds hit slightly softer.
  • Q AD ratio: 105% total AD → 100% total AD
All patch changes →

When to pick Yasuo

✗ Better as a counter-pick

No. He's melee and was nerfed this patch, so long-range mages and crowd-control mids punish a blind pick.

Pick into

  • Projectile-heavy champions whose damage Wind Wall blocks, like Ezreal, Akshan and Jinx
  • Squishy mages who can't stop his dashes, if they lack hard crowd control
  • Teams where your allies have knock-ups for Last Breath
  • Late-game, crit-scaling games where he can carry

Avoid into

  • Point-and-click crowd control he can't Wind Wall, like Lissandra and Malzahar
  • Long-range mages who out-range him, like Aurelion Sol
  • Sustain mages like Vladimir who out-trade him
  • Teams with lots of armor and crowd control

Great teammates

MalphiteMalphite's ultimate knocks up the whole team for a huge Last Breath.
AlistarAlistar's Pulverize knocks enemies up in an area.
GragasGragas's body slam and barrel knock enemies into the air for Yasuo.

Your team needs: Pick Yasuo when your team has knock-ups, so his ultimate has targets.

How to read the enemy team → · Practice drafting →

Strengths

  • Very mobile: dashes through minions and enemies
  • Wind Wall blocks all enemy projectiles
  • Last Breath can lock several airborne enemies in the air at once
  • Scales very well with critical strike items

Weaknesses

  • Very hard to play well
  • Vulnerable to crowd control
  • Melee, so ranged champions poke him in lane
  • Nerfed this patch (26.22)

Power spikes

  • Level 2: Q + E lets you trade well.
  • Level 6: Last Breath gives you kill threat.
  • First item (Immortal Shieldbow): much safer trades.
  • Two items (Infinity Edge): your crits hit very hard.

Top tips

  • Your ultimate works on any airborne enemy, even from your team's knock-ups.
  • Use Wind Wall to block the key skill shot, not just the first one you see.
  • Dash through minions to move around and dodge.
  • Stack Q on minions before trading.
  • Keep moving: your passive shield builds as you walk.
  • Don't dash into the enemy wave without a way out.
